## 2026-11-09T16:25Z Bounded streaming progress shipped

## 2026-11-09T16:26Z Delivery funnel report shipped

- Added `scripts/generation-delivery-funnel.mjs` with `summariseDeliveryFunnel(records, { limit })`. It selects the last 20 eligible full-profile attempts, excludes cancelled, focused, fast-lane, and synthetic records, separates clean, warned, failed, and unknown outcomes, and reports nearest-rank p50/p90 durations for delivered previews.
